title: TCG:LGS-092

power.text:
If both Pyramids are exhausted, put the Pyramidallion into zone 3. If a Pyramid is readied, remove the Pyramidallion from the map.
Lead heroes in this zone get "Free Action: I pick up the Pyramidallion."
